name: issue-loop-core
description: The orchestration engine: work a backlog of ready-for-ai issues to CI-green PRs. Owns the durable /goal loop, rolling cap-3 dispatch, the human-review-response phase, model selection, and stop conditions/backstops. Loads a product's build playbook via a named slot (it does not know how to build any one product). Bundles rework-loop (PR-review-event response). Repo-agnostic; requires github-ops.
